name: colab-idle-guard
description: Reports Colab notebook activity and kernel execution state to the local Colab Idle Guard app so idle Colab runtimes can be released.

commands.title: Pair with Colab Idle Guard app
Treat this notebook as a Colab notebook
Stop treating this notebook as a Colab notebook
Re-check whether this notebook runs on Colab

colabIdleGuard.enabled.description: Report Colab notebook activity and execution state to the local Colab Idle Guard app.

colabIdleGuard.port.description: Port of the Colab Idle Guard app on 127.0.0.1.

enumDescriptions: Check once per kernel session, by running a read-only one-line probe in the kernel, whether the kernel runs on a Colab runtime.
Only notebooks marked with 'Treat this notebook as a Colab notebook' are monitored.
colabIdleGuard.detection.description: How to decide whether a notebook is connected to a Colab runtime.
